nfrs.description: Application form submission (POST /credit-card-applications) must respond within 2 seconds (P99) under normal load. This includes eligibility pre-check computation.
nfrs.rationale: Consumer Duty: customer experience must not be impaired by slow page loads at application stage. FCA complaints risk if form submission appears to hang.

nfrs.description: Application submission endpoint must be available 99.9% of the time during business hours (08:00–22:00 UK time). Planned maintenance windows allowed outside these hours.
nfrs.rationale: Digital-first application channel — unavailability during business hours results in direct revenue loss and Consumer Duty detriment.

nfrs.description: End-to-end credit check turnaround (EVT-041 published to EVT-042 consumed by SVC-003) must complete within 60 seconds (P95). This includes SVC-012 credit bureau API call latency.
nfrs.rationale: Customer expects a near-instant decision. The 60-second P95 target is driven by credit bureau SLA (Experian/Equifax API: < 30s P95) plus internal processing. Exceeding 90s should trigger a fallback path (decision pending notification).

nfrs.description: EVT-041 CreditCheckRequested must be delivered to SVC-012 with exactly-once semantics. Duplicate credit checks on the same application must be prevented (deduplication key: application_id + check_type).
nfrs.target: Zero duplicate hard searches on the same application
nfrs.rationale: Duplicate hard searches are an ICO/FCA conduct risk. Each additional hard search footprint on the customer's credit file without their consent is a UK GDPR breach.

nfrs.description: Automated decisioning (credit policy rules engine) must complete within 5 seconds of EVT-042 being consumed. Overall decision-to-notification latency must not exceed 30 seconds from credit check completion.
nfrs.target: Automated decision: < 5s. Decision notification dispatched: < 30s after EVT-042
nfrs.rationale: Customer expectation for an instant credit card decision. Delays beyond 30 seconds increase application abandonment rate.

nfrs.description: Every automated credit decision must produce an immutable audit record in SVC-103 capturing: application_id, decision, decision_timestamp, policy_rules_evaluated, credit_assessment_reference, assigned_credit_limit (if approved). Retained 6 years.
nfrs.target: 100% of automated decisions audited. Audit record available within 5 seconds of decision.
nfrs.rationale: FCA CONC supervision and UK GDPR Article 22 (automated decision-making). FCA may require evidence of decisioning methodology. Customer may request human review — requires audit trail.

nfrs.description: Virtual card must be available to the customer in the app within 60 seconds of EVT-043 CreditCardApproved being processed.
nfrs.target: Virtual card available: < 60 seconds from approval. P99.
nfrs.rationale: Customer expects to use the card immediately on approval for online purchases. Delay beyond 60 seconds is a Consumer Duty detriment.

nfrs.description: PAN must never be stored in SVC-003's persistence layer, event bus, or any system outside the PCI CDE. All card identifiers in SVC-003 must use card_number_token exclusively. PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5 compliance.
nfrs.target: Zero PAN exposure outside PCI CDE. Verified by quarterly PCI QSA scan and annual PCI DSS v4.0 Report on Compliance (RoC).
nfrs.rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 mandatory compliance for card-issuing banks. PAN exposure outside CDE triggers mandatory breach notification and scheme fines (Visa/Mastercard).

nfrs.description: Card issuance workflow must be idempotent on application_id. Retry of the issuance workflow must not result in duplicate card accounts or duplicate PAN generation.
nfrs.target: Zero duplicate ENT-023 records per application_id. Deduplication enforced at ENT-023 creation (unique constraint: application_id).
nfrs.rationale: Idempotency is required to handle event bus at-least-once delivery and network retries safely without creating duplicate cards.

nfrs.description: Explicit app activation (POST /credit-card-accounts/{id}/activate) must respond within 5 seconds (P99). ENT-023 status transition to 'active' must be committed before response is returned.
nfrs.rationale: Customer experience: activation must feel instant. Delayed status update risks the customer attempting a transaction that fails due to 'not yet active' status.

nfrs.description: Explicit card activation via remote channel must be protected by SCA (two independent authentication factors: possession + knowledge or inherence). PSR 2017 Reg. 100.
nfrs.target: 100% of explicit app activations SCA-gated. Activation API call rejected without valid SCA session token.
nfrs.rationale: PSR 2017 Reg. 100 mandatory obligation. Non-SCA activation is a regulatory breach and creates a fraud liability.

nfrs.description: Monthly statement generation must complete for all active accounts within 2 hours of the scheduled statement_date_day boundary (midnight UTC). 100% of active accounts must receive a statement.
nfrs.target: 100% statement generation. Completion within 2 hours of statement boundary.
nfrs.rationale: CONC 7 — customers must receive timely statements. Missed statements are a regulatory breach. Batch processing window: 00:00–02:00 UTC on statement date.

nfrs.description: Persistent debt monitoring must run at every statement generation event. EVT-048 PersistentDebtAlertTriggered must be published within 30 minutes of EVT-047 StatementGenerated for any account that crosses an FCA CONC 6.7.27 threshold.
nfrs.target: Zero missed persistent debt alerts. EVT-048 published within 30 minutes of EVT-047 for in-scope accounts.
nfrs.rationale: FCA PS20/8 persistent debt rules are a mandatory regulatory obligation. Failure to identify and communicate with persistent debt customers is an FCA enforcement risk.

nfrs.description: Statement history API (GET /credit-card-accounts/{id}/statements) must respond within 3 seconds (P99) for up to 24 months of statement history.
nfrs.target: P50: 800ms, P99: 3s for up to 24-month lookback
nfrs.rationale: Customer and operational support experience. Agents reviewing customer statements for complaint handling require fast retrieval.

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: All CreditCardApplication (ENT-022), CreditCardAccount (ENT-023), and StatementCycle (ENT-025) records must be retained for the life of the account plus 6 years post account closure. WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111) enforces immutability on event records.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: CCA 1974 and CONC require retention of credit agreement records. 6-year post-closure retention aligns with the Limitation Act 1980 (statute of limitations for contract claims).

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: The SVC-003 codebase, infrastructure, and all downstream consumers of SVC-003 events and APIs must be verified for PAN absence annually. PCI DSS v4.0 Report on Compliance (RoC) must confirm SVC-003 is out of scope for the CDE via tokenisation controls.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 mandatory. Visa and Mastercard scheme rules require annual QSA assessment for card-issuing banks.

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: SVC-003 RTO (Recovery Time Objective): 4 hours. RPO (Recovery Point Objective): 15 minutes. No loss of in-flight credit card applications or account records beyond the RPO window.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Credit card applications and account records are financially and legally significant. Inability to recover account records would require FCA notification.

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: All customer-facing UIs for credit card application (PH-023), decision display (PH-025), virtual card viewer (PH-026), and card activation (PH-027) must meet WCAG 2.2 AA standard.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Consumer Duty (PS22/9) and Equality Act 2010. FCA expects banks to support customers with disabilities — digital channel inaccessibility is a Consumer Duty detriment.

regulatory_slas.obligation: Bank must contact customers in persistent debt within prescribed timeframes after threshold reached
regulatory_slas.sla: FCA-mandated communication dispatched within 5 business days of threshold being crossed
regulatory_slas.consequence_of_breach: FCA enforcement action; potential requirement to provide redress to affected customers

regulatory_slas.regulation: Consumer Credit Act 1974 s157 — Right to Know CRA
regulatory_slas.obligation: On decline based on credit reference data, customer must be informed within a reasonable time of which CRA was used
regulatory_slas.sla: Included in decline notification dispatched within 5 minutes of EVT-044 CreditCardDeclined
regulatory_slas.consequence_of_breach: CCA 1974 criminal offence for failure to provide required information

regulatory_slas.obligation: Customer has right to obtain human review of automated credit decision within reasonable timeframe
regulatory_slas.sla: Human review request processed within 2 business days. Customer notified of outcome within 5 business days.
regulatory_slas.consequence_of_breach: ICO enforcement; data subject rights complaint; potential FCA referral

regulatory_slas.obligation: Customer may withdraw from regulated credit agreement within 14 days without penalty
regulatory_slas.sla: Withdrawal processed within 1 business day of customer notification. Account closed, card invalidated.
regulatory_slas.consequence_of_breach: CCA 1974 offence; customer entitled to treat agreement as if it never existed
